source: Generated by an image-generation subagent using the user-supplied convenience-store mockup as a density/style reference.
prompt_summary: Create one wide continuous alpha-transparent grouped exterior planting band for an isometric Japanese convenience-store game. Tall upright trees rise above the future wall line; dense varied green shrubs and modest pink/white flowers form a continuous bed; the bottom ground-contact line stays near-horizontal. No checkerboard, key color, halo, background, buildings, road, text, or signage.
integration: The same grouped asset replaces the compact, intermediate, and 20m perimeter panorama sources. Baseline (100,700)-(2070,700) maps to z=0 at 2.43m beyond the wall; uniform edge-specific scales preserve tree height. Wall/paving occlusion hides the lower stems and roots.
